Part of speech
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to stand (in a certain location or near someone or something); to begin
to stop, to cease, to quit
to install, to place, to mount; to establish, to set
to stick, to adhere; (colloquial) to bother, to pester
